stage_1A_training_budget.finding: Longer training did not improve F1 AUROC in either architecture for seed47; do not repeat stage 1A by default.

stage_1B_window_comparison.finding: F1 AUROC shows no monotonic improvement with longer windows. F1 exceeds F0 at all six architecture/window settings; descriptive development-benchmark evidence only.

next_authorized_work.action: Integrate completed 1A/1B results and limitations into the review draft, reconcile evidence wording, and identify actual advisor/school requirements.
next_authorized_work.scope_note: Expanded methods remain proposals; do not infer that an improved detector is a formal graduation requirement.

decision_rules: Use this operational state before dated historical narrative; cite its source record.
Model output is a proposal, never execution permission or scientific evidence.
Do not claim stage 1B performance improvement before real results exist.
Existing test is a development benchmark, not a new holdout.
Human review is required for changes to thesis claims or contradictory evidence.
A new local model profile is not a fine-tuned or newly trained foundation model.
metric_audit: Stage 1B uses a tie-aware AUROC/AP helper. The impact of the old helper on historical reported metrics has not been quantified.

local_model.next_step: Collect independent failure, resume, and human-reviewed ambiguous cases; high-confidence PARTIAL error remains.

graduation.recommendation: Prioritize manuscript, evidence traceability and defense preparation. Add experiments only for a specific unresolved claim or confirmed advisor requirement.
